```{r}
#| warning: false

packages <- c(
    "renv",
    "dplyr",
    "purrr",
    "here",
    "tidyr",
    "MetBrewer",
    "ggplot2",
    "patchwork",
    "magrittr",
    "ComplexHeatmap",
    "devtools",
    # Single Cell
    "Seurat",
    # Single Cell plotting
    "SCpubr",
    # Fast Wilcoxon rank sum test and auROC analysis
    "presto"
)
# Install
installed_packages <- packages %in%
    rownames(installed.packages())
if (any(installed_packages == F)) {
    install.packages(packages[!installed_packages])
}
# Load
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
    invisible(lapply(packages, library, character.only = T))
})
```

# Helper functions for QC

```{r}
.processing_objects <- function(
    SEURAT_OBJECT, 
    MIN_FEATURES, 
    MAX_FEATURES, 
    PERCENT_MT = NULL) {
    #' Preprocess Seurat object by applying QC metrics
    #'
    #' @param SEURAT_OBJECT Seurat object to preprocess
    #' @param MIN_FEATURES Minimum number of detected features per cell
    #' @param MAX_FEATURES Maximum number of detected features per cell
    #' @param PERCENT_MT Maximum allowed mitochondrial percentage per cell (`NULL` by default)
    #' @return Filtered Seurat object

    SEURAT_OBJECT <- subset(
        SEURAT_OBJECT,
        subset = nFeature_RNA > MIN_FEATURES
        & nFeature_RNA < MAX_FEATURES
        & percent.mt < PERCENT_MT
    )

    SEURAT_OBJECT
}

.normalizing_plus_hvFeatures <- function(
    SEURAT_OBJECT) {
    #' Apply normalization and find Highly Variable Features
    #'
    #' @param SEURAT_OBJECT
    #' @comment default argument in use
    #' @return SEURAT_OBJECT
    
    SEURAT_OBJECT <- Seurat::NormalizeData(
        SEURAT_OBJECT,
        normalization.method = "LogNormalize",
        scale.factor = 10000
    )

    SEURAT_OBJECT <- Seurat::FindVariableFeatures(
        SEURAT_OBJECT, 
        selection.method = "vst",
        nfeatures = 2000
    )

    SEURAT_OBJECT
}

.dim_heatmap_ch <- function(
    SEURAT_OBJECT,
    P_COMP = NULL,
    N_GENES = NULL,
    TITLE = NULL) {
    #' Plot heatmap to identify source of heterogeneity
    #'
    #' @param SEURAT_OBJECT Seurat object post PCA and feature identification
    #' @param P_COMP Principal component to plot (integer)
    #' @param N_GENES Number of top and bottom genes by PC loading score
    #' @param TITLE String for the heatmap title
    #' @return ComplexHeatmap object

    # Extract PC loadings and select top/bottom N genes
    LOADINGS <- Seurat::Loadings(SEURAT_OBJECT, reduction = "pca")[, P_COMP]
    TOP_GENES <- names(sort(LOADINGS, decreasing = TRUE)[1:N_GENES])
    BOTTOM_GENES <- names(sort(LOADINGS, decreasing = FALSE)[1:N_GENES])
    SELECTED_GENES <- c(TOP_GENES, BOTTOM_GENES)

    # Sort cells by PC embedding score — this is what creates visible blocks
    EMBEDDINGS <- Seurat::Embeddings(SEURAT_OBJECT, reduction = "pca")[, P_COMP]
    SORTED_CELLS <- names(sort(EMBEDDINGS, decreasing = TRUE))

    # Extract scaled expression matrix — genes as rows, sorted cells as columns
    MATRIX <- Seurat::GetAssayData(
        SEURAT_OBJECT,
        layer = "scale.data"
    )[SELECTED_GENES, SORTED_CELLS]

    # Cell metadata annotation (color bar on top)
    CELL_IDENTITY <- as.factor(Seurat::Idents(SEURAT_OBJECT))[SORTED_CELLS]
    ANNOTATION_COLORS <- setNames(
        MetBrewer::met.brewer("Redon", length(levels(CELL_IDENTITY))),
        levels(CELL_IDENTITY)
    )
    TOP_ANNOTATION <- ComplexHeatmap::HeatmapAnnotation(
        Identity = CELL_IDENTITY,
        col = list(Identity = ANNOTATION_COLORS)
    )

    # Plot
    HT <- ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap(
        matrix = MATRIX,
        name = "Scaled Expression",
        column_title = TITLE,
        top_annotation = TOP_ANNOTATION,
        cluster_rows = FALSE,
        cluster_columns = FALSE,
        show_column_names = FALSE,
        show_row_names = TRUE,
        row_names_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 8)
    )

    FN <- function() ComplexHeatmap::draw(HT)
    ggplotify::as.ggplot(FN)
}
```

# Helper function for cell clustering
 
```{r}
.dim_umap_scpub <- function(
    SEURAT_OBJECT,
    POINT_SIZE = NULL,
    LABEL_SIZE = NULL,
    LABEL = FALSE,
    PALETTE = NULL) {
    #' Generate UMAP publication-ready plot
    #'
    #' @param SEURAT_OBJECT Seurat object post clustering and UMAP reduction
    #' @param POINT_SIZE Point size for cells
    #' @param LABEL_SIZE Cluster label size
    #' @param PALETTE MetBrewer palette name
    #' @return ggplot2 object

    CLUSTER_IDS <- levels(Seurat::Idents(SEURAT_OBJECT))
    N_CLUSTERS <- length(CLUSTER_IDS)
    PALETTE_MAX <- length(MetBrewer::met.brewer(PALETTE))

    COLORS <- setNames(
        if (N_CLUSTERS > PALETTE_MAX) {
            MetBrewer::met.brewer(PALETTE, n = N_CLUSTERS, type = "continuous")
        } else {
            MetBrewer::met.brewer(PALETTE, n = N_CLUSTERS, type = "discrete")
        },
        CLUSTER_IDS
    )

    SCpubr::do_DimPlot(
    sample = SEURAT_OBJECT,
    reduction = "umap",
    pt.size = POINT_SIZE,
    label = LABEL,
    label.box = FALSE,
    label.size = LABEL_SIZE,
    colors.use = COLORS
    )
}

.vln_plot_markers <- function(
    SEURAT_OBJECT,
    MARKERS = NULL,
    PALETTE = NULL) {
    #' Violin plots for marker genes arranged in a grid
    #'
    #' @param SEURAT_OBJECT Seurat object post marker identification
    #' @param MARKERS character vector of marker genes to plot
    #' @param PALETTE MetBrewer palette name
    #' @return patchwork grid of violin plots

    N_CLUSTERS <- length(levels(Seurat::Idents(SEURAT_OBJECT)))
    PALETTE_MAX <- length(MetBrewer::met.brewer(PALETTE))

    COLORS <- setNames(
        if (N_CLUSTERS > PALETTE_MAX) {
            MetBrewer::met.brewer(PALETTE, n = N_CLUSTERS, type = "continuous")
        } else {
            MetBrewer::met.brewer(PALETTE, n = N_CLUSTERS, type = "discrete")
        },
        levels(Seurat::Idents(SEURAT_OBJECT))
    )

    purrr::map(MARKERS, ~ SCpubr::do_ViolinPlot(
        sample = SEURAT_OBJECT,
        features = .x,
        colors.use = COLORS
    )) %>%
        patchwork::wrap_plots()
}

.feature_plot_markers <- function(
    SEURAT_OBJECT,
    MARKERS = NULL,
    PALATTE = NULL,
    COLORS = NULL) {
    #' Feature plots for marker genes arranged in a grid
    #'
    #' @param SEURAT_OBJECT Seurat object post marker identification
    #' @param MARKERS character vector of marker genes to plot
    #' @param PALETTE MetBrewer palette name, defaults to "Redon"
    #' @return patchwork grid of feature plots

    # COLORS <- MetBrewer::met.brewer(PALETTE, type = "continuous")

    purrr::map(MARKERS, ~ SCpubr::do_FeaturePlot(
        sample = SEURAT_OBJECT,
        features = .x,
        sequential.palette = COLORS
    )) %>%
        patchwork::wrap_plots()
}

.cluster_heatmap_ch <- function(
    SEURAT_OBJECT,
    MARKERS,
    PALETTE = NULL,
    TITLE = NULL) {
    #' Plot heatmap of top marker genes per cluster
    #'
    #' @param SEURAT_OBJECT Seurat object post marker identification
    #' @param MARKERS dataframe from FindAllMarkers() filtered to desired genes
    #' @param PALETTE MetBrewer palette name, defaults to "Redon"
    #' @param TITLE String for the heatmap title
    #' @return ComplexHeatmap ggplot2 object

    # Extract gene order and scaled matrix
    SELECTED_GENES <- unique(MARKERS$gene)
    MATRIX <- Seurat::GetAssayData(
        SEURAT_OBJECT,
        layer = "scale.data"
    )[SELECTED_GENES, ]

    # Sort cells by cluster identity
    CELL_IDENTITY <- Seurat::Idents(SEURAT_OBJECT)
    SORTED_CELLS <- names(sort(CELL_IDENTITY))
    MATRIX <- MATRIX[, SORTED_CELLS]

    # Cluster annotation color bar
    CLUSTER_IDS <- levels(CELL_IDENTITY)
    N_CLUSTERS <- length(CLUSTER_IDS)
    PALETTE_MAX <- length(MetBrewer::met.brewer(PALETTE))

    ANNOTATION_COLORS <- setNames(
        if (N_CLUSTERS > PALETTE_MAX) {
            MetBrewer::met.brewer(PALETTE, n = N_CLUSTERS, type = "continuous")
        } else {
            MetBrewer::met.brewer(PALETTE, n = N_CLUSTERS, type = "discrete")
        },
        CLUSTER_IDS
    )

    TOP_ANNOTATION <- ComplexHeatmap::HeatmapAnnotation(
        Cluster = as.factor(CELL_IDENTITY)[SORTED_CELLS],
        col = list(Cluster = ANNOTATION_COLORS)
    )

    HT <- ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap(
        matrix = MATRIX,
        name = "Scaled Expression",
        column_title = TITLE,
        top_annotation = TOP_ANNOTATION,
        cluster_rows = FALSE,
        cluster_columns = FALSE,
        show_column_names = FALSE,
        show_row_names = TRUE,
        row_names_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 8)
    )

    FN <- function() ComplexHeatmap::draw(HT)
    ggplotify::as.ggplot(FN)
}
```
